verdict.rationale: GitHub documents applying Copilot review suggestions "with a couple of clicks" and launching a cloud-based development environment in seconds. Its Mobile app can "edit files in pull requests", and GitHub.com lets you delegate coding changes to Copilot without leaving the site. None of this explicitly shows a developer editing files and committing in the browser in response to human review comments. Missing for 10: explicit docs of an in-browser file editor and commit flow on PR branches, applying human reviewers' suggested changes in the web UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
